messages:
nelly: Quick thread 9:30 several customers reported fncall schema rejects being counted against /chat.generate quotas. Small numbers but high noise.

rahul: do we have a sample req id?

nelly: req ef12e9, 2026-02-12T09:25:10Z. validator returned invalid_function_output and console shows /chat.generate.

kai: short root cause: pipeline refactor moved route-resolution after validator, so early failures pick default route.

nelly: options?

kai: 1) move route-resolver earlier (bigger change), 2) propagate route-hint header at ingress and make validator prefer it (small), 3) post-process billing events to remap based on error_kind (dangerous for accounting).

rahul: prefer #2. low risk and reversible. We already have x-route-hint but its optional. populate it from route table at auth stage. validator reads header and tags validation errors accordingly.

nelly: can we ship a short-term shim to avoid more misbills while we roll?

kai: implement validator fallback: if error_kind==invalid_function_output and header missing, set billing.route to /fncall before emitting billing event. Put behind ff.

infra-bot: note: any server change must be feature-flagged and have a 10% canary across hosted/dedicated.

rahul: i'll open the PR for header population + validator fallback. will include unit + integration to assert billing.route for validation errors.

billing-team: please produce a CSV of impacted reqs grouped by customer for 2026-02-11 -> 2026-02-12 so we can reconcile if needed.

nelly: ops, can you run a dry-run count?

infra-bot: dry-run: predicate "validation.error_kind:invalid_function_output AND billing.route:'/chat.generate'" between 2026-02-11T00:00 and 2026-02-12T12:00 => 149 matches.

rahul: small but not negligible. we'll push PR today, canary tomorrow, and coordinate backfill with billing.

nelly: thanks. once PR is up i'll post a short status in #support and add a temporary dashboard alert for mislabels > 3/hr.

kai: adding telemetry: validation errors will emit route_hint in payload so billing processing can remap if needed. small change, helps post-process accuracy.

rahul: noted. i'll include migration script template for ops to patch past events.

nelly: sound plan.
